P1 = 3x^2 + 5x^0
P2 = 2x^1 + 4x^0

  x^1 only in 2nd: copy 2x^1
  x^0 in both: 5 + 4 = 9 -> 9x^0

--- Multiplication: every term times every term ---
  term * term = product  -> result so far

  (3x^2) * (4x^0) = 12x^2  -> 6x^3 + 12x^2

Experiment 13: Sorting Benchmark
Bubble, Insertion, Radix, Quick and Merge sort
=======================================================
How steps are counted (same rules for every sort):
  comparison  = one test between two keys, e.g. a[j] > a[j+1]
  move        = one element assignment: swap = 3 moves,
                shift = 1, copy to/from a temp array = 1
  total steps = comparisons + moves
  radix       = n-1 comparisons (find max) + 2n moves per pass

Case 1: sample data (n = 7)
Input : 64 34 25 12 22 11 90
Sorted: 11 12 22 25 34 64 90
All five results match
Algorithm              Comparisons   Moves  Total steps
-------------------------------------------------------
Bubble (early exit)             21      42           63
Insertion (shifting)            16      26           42
Radix (LSD, base 10)             6      28           34
Quick (Lomuto)                  19      48           67
Merge (top-down)                13      40           53

Observations:
- Bubble and insertion: fewest steps on sorted input, most
  on reverse input (every pair is out of order).

- Radix and merge moves do not depend on the input order.
